recommendation: Keep this source-changing reconciliation as-is. It completes the published FHIR-37889 removal using the same treatment already applied to the matching empty registry file under FHIR-40117.
issue_request: FHIR-37889 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Vocabulary change request asking that the Terminology and Identity System NamingSystem example bundles at namingsystem-terminologies.html and namingsystem-registry.html be removed because they duplicated content authoritatively maintained in HL7 Terminology and could become misleading.
initial_application: Commit 76c99d3aae applied the issue by removing the contents of source/namingsystem/namingsystem-registry.xml and source/namingsystem/namingsystem-terminologies.xml, but left both as empty Bundle resources. Commit ededc6fc84 later removed the empty registry file for FHIR-40117, leaving source/namingsystem/namingsystem-terminologies.xml as the remaining source artifact from the FHIR-37889 bundle pair.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, so files in source/namingsystem are in current build scope. The current NamingSystem examples list no longer references the terminology or registry bundles, and source/namingsystem/namingsystem-registry.xml is already absent. Vocabulary minutes from 2022-08-15 record FHIR-37889 as resolved with a recommendation to delete the page, and FHIR-40117 records the later conclusion that the empty registry file should not exist at all. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Deleted source/namingsystem/namingsystem-terminologies.xml, the remaining empty Bundle source file, and published the fix as commit 87f89ac54f58014e14ceb2b093540c8ff796978b on the combined branch.
source_changes: Deleted source/namingsystem/namingsystem-terminologies.xml, an empty Bundle with id terminologies that remained after the original FHIR-37889 application.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive follow-up concluded the empty namingsystem-registry.xml file should not exist and removed it, supporting the same cleanup for the remaining empty terminologies bundle.
Vocabulary minutes note this DICOM NamingSystem request no longer needed application because FHIR-37889 recommended deleting the page.
